scientific_limitations: The hierarchy is for dense torus points and prime powers q at least five, not all projective-scroll points, smaller fields, or scheme lengths. The earlier Hansen preprint has only month-precision public dating (August 2000); 2002-08-21 is the earliest exact-day-verified cited original toric-code source, not a fabricated 2000 date.
title: Finite-torus linear-section profile of the quartic rational normal scroll
